12 run artifacts in predecessor capture, not paired events. Portfolio-record membership or same-date Watch does not establish original pairing.
Exact existing incumbent alternative required; cash alternative is not incumbent continuation. Assurance must link authentic comparison, not originate a missing pair.
Zero stored paper outcomes. Single-instrument fill/PnL and unit/fixed-notional sizing cannot replace paired parcel. An exact original rotation reference would need independent validation.
Zero studies/events, three run receipts in predecessor capture. time_stop_sessions is setup/paper policy, not governed common comparison horizon.

Audit and internal references may reconstruct an existing comparison; final_public_decision and outcome-link type do not prove a pair/return. Verify original canonical fingerprints and complete dependency closure.

ROTATION_EVALUATED plus frozen references may locate existing replay observation; generic signal/event does not synthesize a pair. Simulated population stays separately labelled.

source_classifications.schema: Signal / TradePlan with exact historical replay references
source_classifications.limits: Signal/entry/expiry/stop/target are not an incumbent, common horizon or expected return. P1 projections likewise do not supply a portfolio parcel.
Bars may supply admitted feature/realized evidence only; neither their abundance nor later scanning creates an original rotation event.

types.id: Nonempty canonical identifier; exact source-specific validation, no fuzzy match.
types.fingerprint: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex; legacy source digests require lossless namespaced wrapper retaining exact original digest and verifier.
types.utc: Timezone-aware instant, normalized UTC ISO8601; no local/naive/default time.
types.decimal: Finite canonical decimal string, nonexponent insignificant zeros removed, negative zero to zero, no implicit rounding.
types.arrays: Immutable ordered representation after duplicate/conflict validation; source refs sorted by role/id/version; all nulls explicit.
types.nullable: ? permits null only with matching unavailable state/reason; empty identity cannot replace null.

identity.horizon_fingerprint: SHA256 normalized complete HorizonBinding excluding only fingerprint; verifies frozen policy/calendar/start/end binding, never grants policy authority.
identity.incomplete_identity: Do not mint PairedObservation if origin/pair/parcel/horizon/methodology bindings cannot be established; emit retained RejectionReceipt with observation_id=null.
identity.decision_fingerprint: SHA256 repository canonical JSON of full normalized DecisionSnapshot excluding only decision_fingerprint; contains no outcome, maturity, research time or observation ID.
identity.outcome_fingerprint: SHA256 normalized complete Outcome excluding only outcome_fingerprint; includes observation_id which excludes outcomes.
identity.revision_fingerprint: SHA256 normalized complete PairedObservation excluding only revision_fingerprint; all nulls, reasons, research_as_of and supersedes_revision included.
identity.receipt_fingerprint: SHA256 normalized complete RejectionReceipt excluding receipt_id and receipt_fingerprint.
identity.normalization: Validate source fingerprints before transformation; UTC, exact decimals, no locale/environment/clock; use repository canonical_json/content_fingerprint. Distinguish source fingerprint formats via explicit wrapper, never rewrite original values.
identity.duplicate_semantics: Exact original id/version/payload repeats are aliases counted once with retained receipts; same id/version conflicting content rejects. Never silently set-deduplicate conflicting lineage.
identity.revisions: Same frozen decision inputs imply same observation ID across maturity/label revisions. Append immutable revisions; later correction cannot overwrite prior decision/label/cohort. Logical original event grouping prevents corrected versions inflating sample size.

findings: B09 is conditional fundamental V2 applicability, not economic duration.
SHORT_TERM/POSITIONAL/LONG_TERM candidate durations UNSET and NOT_ACTIVE.
Paper time_stop_sessions and strategy expiry have different semantics; cannot be renamed.
Canonical calendar resolves sessions, not a holding horizon.
requirements: Exact independent approved/selected/effective policy at D, selection known_at <= D; effective boundary semantics of that exact canonical policy reused without reinterpretation.
One identical binding per pair with D <= start < end; start/end rule, calendar version, phase, precision and same-family wealth method pinned.
No future choice using realized outcomes; unresolved exceptional-calendar/suspension/delist semantics block, not arbitrary extension or shortening.
Frozen horizon endpoint not rebound to a later calendar edition. Later proven closure/conflict produces retained unresolved/excluded revision; future exception policy separately governed.
Original calendar membership selection uses D evidence; canonical completion/realized notices may use R evidence only in research partition.

time_partitions.decision: All transitive features/source event-effective-known/approval-selection timestamps must satisfy their canonical source rule at D; never use latest() without explicit D.
time_partitions.research: Realized economic events within the pinned outcome method/window, terminal exact endpoint, evidence available by explicit R; disclosures/corrections can arrive after end but only in research revision visible by R.
time_partitions.replay_origin: ARCHIVED_DECISION requires original event available by D. FROZEN_REPLAY may be materialized later only if retained deterministic run/input manifest proves simulated decision from D-visible inputs and historically valid policy; distinct population, never real historical decision. This slice creates neither.
time_partitions.replay_metadata_exception: Only the authenticated original replay record and run_manifest_ref may have creation/knownness after simulated D but <= R. They are administrative provenance with roles ORIGIN_RECORD/REPLAY_MANIFEST, not members of the predictive decision evidence array. The independently verified frozen run must resolve its complete input/configuration closure at D. No feature, outcome or policy approval may use this exception; no actual historical decision is inferred.
time_partitions.context: Strategy/archetype, regime, sector, volatility and diagnostics are original decision features only; missing unavailable, conflict excluded when mandatory. No hindsight taxonomy/regime repair.
time_partitions.clock: R supplied as canonical research cutoff with R >= D, never datetime.now for historical interpretation.

rules: Missing/invalid horizon or calendar => UNRESOLVED, no labels.
R < pinned end => PENDING_MATURITY; no realized label object or scalar.
R >= end AND exact terminal session/phase canonically completed with proof known_at <= R => MATURE.
MATURE does not imply terminal prices, both legs, cost coverage or cohort admission. Missing/conflicted completion proof => UNRESOLVED.
maturity.at_endpoint: Equality R=end allowed only with exact completed-session proof already known; no active-session completion shortcut.

rules.rule: Authenticate retained original event and comparison; price-derived or invented origins cannot qualify.
Resolve exact distinct securities, selected parcel and capital from original immutable references; no discretionary substitutions.
Resolve exact policy/input closure at decision cutoff with original payload verification, source-specific temporal roles and no later evidence.
Bind identical cutoff, horizon, C, INR, protocol and same outcome methodology for both legs.
Exact horizon selection/approval/effectiveness visible at decision; category/duration unset blocks, not a default.
Require explicit research cutoff at/after frozen horizon end and canonical proof terminal session/phase completed; date passage alone cannot mature.
Realized source evidence may be future of decision but must be visible by research cutoff and never copied into decision inputs.
Require exact governed start/end price references, source timing, identity, coverage and adjustment/economic continuity.
Require both legs complete and funding, quantity, residual, precision and realized-wealth policy verified; incomplete legs cannot produce a paired scalar.
Retain authentic negative/rejected/delisted observations and all exclusions in original denominator; no current-universe filter.
Deduplicate exact logical origin aliases before counting; contradictions reject; overlapping independent origins remain retained and grouped for dependence review.
Gross research admission is not net-economic or model-training eligibility; missing cost/tax/slippage remains explicit, net always null.
Model fit accepts only admitted eligible labels matured and available by fit cutoff, with frozen split/model before OOS start and no overlapping dependent leakage.

admission.definition: ADMITTED means mature complete cost-exclusive paired research label only, never calibrated/model-ready/net-authoritative.
admission.primary_reason: All applicable unique codes retained in exclusion_taxonomy order; primary first; order is deterministic reporting precedence, not severity or authority.
admission.invalid_input: Malformed/unidentifiable source retained via RejectionReceipt; never invent missing observation identity.
admission.receipt_retention: Every reviewed source candidate and exclusion retained in future immutable research manifest; this slice writes no cohort or database.

exclusion_taxonomy.meaning: Malformed, empty, extra or wrongly typed contract field; nonfinite money or naive timestamp.
Exact source identity/version/content fingerprint fails original verification; never repair by rehashing.
Conflicting values/versions or incompatible equal-time provenance; no arbitrary tie-break.
No retained decision-origin record and input closure; price-only, invented, AI or analyst origin.
Original canonical decision cutoff is absent.
Exact original incumbent cannot be established.
Exact original challenger cannot be established.
Collision, fuzzy mapping, same security on both sides or unresolved continuity.
No exact decision-bound selected incumbent parcel/capital proof; whole holding is not a default.
Source kind/security unsupported by the applicable admitted research policy.
Cutoff, capital, protocol, horizon or methodology differs between sides; benchmark substitute.
Decision source/policy unavailable, future-effective or future-known at original cutoff.
Realized outcome, later restatement or outcome-derived feature enters frozen decision evidence.
No exact approved/effective horizon authority at decision cutoff.
Multiple incompatible horizons or categorical-to-duration mapping unresolved.
Hindsight extension, shortening or calendar rebinding of a frozen observation.
Required session/phase coverage missing or contradictory, including unexpected closure.
Pinned terminal session/phase not yet proven completed at explicit research as-of.
Method-required historical source coverage is not proven.
Exact governed start/reference evidence absent; no nearest/last/average fallback.
Exact governed terminal observation absent at research as-of.
Required realized evidence not visible by research as-of, even if horizon completed.
Split/bonus/cash/complex action treatment, coverage or economic conservation unresolved.
Mixed/unknown/undocumented adjustment or return basis.
Endpoint/tradeability/fill interpretation not governed for this suspension/circuit.
No governed terminal economic treatment; no zero, last-price or winner-only deletion.
Non-INR capital/endpoints or auxiliary percentage substituted for INR.
Missing funding/quantity/residual proof; fractional shares or cash assumptions prohibited.
No versioned paired realized-wealth/precision methodology; no ad hoc arithmetic admission.
Only one side or incomplete input closure; partial evidence not a paired label.
Present-day membership/winner filter or missing failed-origin denominator.
Exact logical origin already represented; retain alias receipt, count once.
Representativeness, dependence or adequacy policy unresolved; no calibrated claim.
No frozen chronological split/overlap/purge/embargo/adequacy policy.
Test data used in fit/selection; future-matured labels or shared event/dependent interval leaks across split.
Claimed research/AI/self-hash provenance cannot confer Gate-1 scenario authority.

outcomes.partial: After verified maturity, isolated raw leg evidence may be retained as PARTIAL_EVIDENCE. All paired PnL/advantage scalars null and admission EXCLUDED; not a training sample.
outcomes.gross: Only fully admitted identical-method legs with exact capital/quantity/residual/continuity/precision proof can supply PAIRED_GROSS_COMPLETE. Mandatory unresolved costs remain listed; no final Gate1 net result.
outcomes.formulas_are: Conditional accounting identities from same-C frozen predecessor, not a terminal valuation method or forecast.
outcomes.return_percentage_reason: No research percentage precision/denominator policy selected; future auxiliary statistic cannot replace INR comparator.
outcomes.cost_scope: Cost-exclusive endpoints; missing costs do not prevent a fully qualified gross-only label but do block net economics. Funding/quantity/residual/wealth-method gaps DO prevent paired gross admission. No tax/slippage/fee zero fill.

prices_and_actions.endpoint_policy: Source, provider/version, normalization, instrument, market/session/phase, price field, event time, known-at, completeness, conflict and precision rules explicit in later approved outcome method. No arbitrary close/open/LTP/nearest substitution.
prices_and_actions.start: Reference prices and starting C admitted at D. Do not use an end-of-day bar not yet known at intraday D or a future fill as a D feature.
prices_and_actions.terminal: Exact pinned endpoint observation and complete source lineage visible at R; not any price <=R. Suspension/no bar/circuit absence stays missing, not unchanged price.
prices_and_actions.basis: No mixed RAW/ADJUSTED/UNKNOWN endpoints; verified same economic basis and no double applying factors or adjusting both quantity and price twice.

corporate_actions.support: Verified technical factors reusable as evidence; exact units/parcel conversion and economic-method approval still required; technical derivative alone not wealth.
Cash distribution/reinvestment/price-return exclusion methodology not approved; no silently omitted dividend or invented total return.
Consideration, successor holdings/cash and coverage unresolved; fail closed and retain reason.
Exact source-backed canonical identity continuity only; symbol-string change is not a new security nor fuzzy join.
No zero, last-close or automatic horizon extension; missing terminal treatment excluded but original denominator retained.

prices_and_actions.universe: Eligibility resolved at original D from historical membership/lifecycle evidence, never present-day membership. Out-of-universe/delisted after D not a reason to erase original event; invalid outcome retained with exclusion.

sampling.true_observation_count: Distinct authenticated original comparison keys with exact paired parcel/horizon; versions/aliases not new independent decisions.
sampling.dependence: Same logical event aliases counted once. Distinct origins sharing either instrument over intersecting inclusive decision-to-label-maturity intervals flagged; same instrument/time/strategy exposure may remain correlated even without overlap. No invented independence, downweighting coefficient or near-duplicate cutoff.
sampling.bias: Rejected/failed/negative/delisted originals retained before labels inspected; conditioning and minimum adequacy need later policy. Raw bar count and report-link count never sample count.
sampling.conditioning: Preserve original nullable context; do not require regime/strategy conditioning until later sufficiency policy. Unknown group explicitly reported; no hindsight filling.

requirements: Freeze split id/version/fingerprint, cohort/revision references, original-event grouping, time bounds, endpoint inclusivity, fit cutoff F, model version, evaluation start/end and selection timestamp.

Training/validation label maturity AND label availability <= F; decision inputs frozen at their D; F <= model/selection freeze < TEST start using existing strict pre-TEST walk-forward convention. The frozen model must also be known by each evaluated D.
All aliases and dependent overlapping information/outcome intervals remain isolated across calibration/validation/OOS or excluded under a later approved purge policy; no zero purge/embargo default.
Validation is for selection and not reused as untouched OOS; no fitting/threshold selection on test results.
OOS labels revealed only after each observation's maturity; subsequent recalibration is a new version using only labels available by its own F, never rewrites earlier predictions.
Existing WalkForwardPlan requires numeric window/purge/embargo/minimum parameters; this protocol does not populate them or run it.

Exact policy-bound start/end and eligible paired history unproved.
Verified split/bonus technical factors are not complete economic wealth/complex-action treatment.
Existing immutable snapshot/ledger replay conditional on complete historical known-at closure.
Protocol admission requirements defined; horizon/wealth/funding/precision prerequisites absent, no real paired label.
No fractional/default quantity or residual/fee financing inferred.
No complete historical applicable tariff/source admission.
Mandatory tax policy/lots/context unresolved; no rate invented.

Walk-forward support exists; split/sample/overlap/adequacy policy unapproved.
Research references and hashes confer no scenario authority; no producer registered.
